name: TheForge Buy Now Button for WooCommerce – Direct Checkout & Quick Purchase
author: thepluginforge

sections.description:
TheForge Buy Now Button transforms your WooCommerce store by adding a powerful “Buy Now” button that takes customers directly to checkout, skipping the shopping cart entirely. Perfect for reducing friction, increasing conversions, and creating urgency with real-time stock alerts.

Why Choose TheForge Buy Now Button?

  • Instant Checkout – Skip the cart, boost conversions by up to 30%
  • Stock Urgency Messages – Show “Only X left in stock!” alerts automatically
  • Separate Alignments – Different button positions for single products vs. shop pages
  • Analytics Dashboard – Track views, clicks, and conversion rates in real-time
  • Beautiful Icons – Add cart, lightning, fire, or star icons to your button
  • 4 Button Styles – Solid, Outline, Gradient, or 3D effects
  • Smart Stock Management – Auto-hide button when products are out of stock
  • Full Customization – Colors, sizes, borders, text – everything is customizable

Key Features

Button Customization:
* Custom button text (e.g., “Buy Now”, “Order Now”, “Quick Purchase”)
* Color picker for background and text colors
* 3 size options: Small, Medium, Large
* Separate alignments for single product pages and shop/archive pages
* Border radius slider (0-50px)
* Button width: Auto or Full-width
* Custom CSS class support

Stock & Urgency:
* Automatic stock urgency messages (“Only 3 left in stock – Order now!”)
* Customizable stock threshold (default: 5 items)
* Auto-hide button for out-of-stock products
* Professional alert styling with red accent borders

Button Styles:
* Solid – Classic filled button
* Outline – Border-only design
* Gradient – Modern gradient background
* 3D – Raised button with shadow effects

Icon Options:
* Shopping Cart, Lightning Bolt, Arrow, Checkmark, Fire, Star
* Position: Left or Right of text

Analytics & Tracking:
* Track button views and clicks
* Monitor conversion rates
* View top products by Buy Now clicks
* Filter by: Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, All Time

Advanced Settings:
* Redirect to: Checkout, Cart, or Custom URL
* Category targeting (enable for specific categories only)
* Shortcode support: [spcb_buy_now product_id="123"]
* HPOS compatible

Easy Setup Guide

Step 1: Install & Activate
1. Install from WordPress.org or upload the plugin ZIP
2. Click “Activate”
3. Go to WooCommerce → TheForge Buy Now Button

Step 2: Configure Basic Settings (General Tab)
* Enable Buy Now Button (checked by default)
* Choose redirect: Checkout (recommended), Cart, or Custom URL
* (Optional) Select specific categories

Step 3: Style Your Button (Button Styling Tab)
* Button Text: “Buy Now” (or customize)
* Button Color: Choose your brand color
* Text Color: White or contrast color
* Button Size: Medium (recommended)
* Single Product Alignment: Left (works with variations)
* Shop/Archive Alignment: Center (looks great in grids)
* Button Style: Solid, Outline, Gradient, or 3D
* Border Radius: 4px
* (Optional) Add an Icon: Lightning, Cart, Fire, etc.

Step 4: Enable Stock Urgency (Advanced Tab)
* Check “Hide for Out of Stock”
* Check “Show stock urgency message”
* Stock Urgency Threshold: 5

Important: Your products must have “Manage stock?” enabled:
* Edit Product → Inventory → Check “Manage stock?”
* Set stock quantity

Step 5: Save & Test
* Click “Save Changes”
* Visit a product page to see your button!

How It Works

  1. Customer clicks “Buy Now” button
  2. Plugin clears cart
  3. Adds product to cart
  4. Redirects to checkout
  5. Customer completes purchase quickly!

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0+
  • WooCommerce 3.0+
  • PHP 7.0+

Support

  • Documentation: https://thepluginforge.com/support
  • Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/theforge-single-product-checkout/
  • Email: support@thepluginforge.com

Privacy

  • Stores analytics locally in WordPress database
  • Does NOT send data to external servers
  • Does NOT collect personal customer information
  • Only tracks button views and clicks
  • GDPR compliant

Credits

Developed by The Plugin Forge – Crafting powerful WordPress & WooCommerce solutions.

Thank you for using TheForge Buy Now Button! If you find it helpful, please leave a 5-star review!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “TheForge Buy Now Button”
  3. Click Install Now → Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce → TheForge Buy Now Button

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose ZIP file → Install Now → Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce → TheForge Buy Now Button
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! WooCommerce is required.

Will it work with variable products?

Yes! Customers select their options first, then click Buy Now.

How do I enable stock urgency messages?

  1. Enable “Manage stock?” in product Inventory settings
  2. Set stock quantity
  3. Plugin Advanced tab → Check “Show stock urgency message”
  4. Set Stock Urgency Threshold (e.g., 5)

Can I use different alignments for different pages?

Yes! Set separate alignments for Single Product pages and Shop/Archive pages in the Button Styling tab.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes! Works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight with minimal performance impact.
